description: This file defines the CalendarGrid class, which manages rendering of calendar views such as day, week, month, and year in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for generating HTML structures for various calendar grid layouts, handling mobile views, and supporting shared calendars.

classes.name: CalendarGrid
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering calendar grids for various views in SuiteCRM, including day, week, month, year, shared, and mobile views. Handles HTML generation and layout specifics.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CalendarGrid instance, setting dates, weekdays, and visual options based on the Calendar object.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to generate and return the HTML for the current calendar view.

methods.name: get_time_column
methods.description: Generates HTML for the time labels column, used in grid views.

methods.name: get_day_column
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual day columns with time slots.

methods.name: display_mobile
methods.description: Produces HTML for the mobile-friendly view of calendar items.

methods.name: mobile_display_items
methods.description: Formats individual calendar items for the mobile view.

methods.name: mobile_get_end_time
methods.description: Calculates the end time of a mobile calendar item based on start time and duration.

methods.name: mobile_get_type_colour
methods.description: Returns color associated with the type of mobile calendar item (meeting, call, task).

methods.name: mobile_get_status_colour
methods.description: Returns color for the status of a mobile calendar item.

methods.name: get_basic_cell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a basic calendar cell with specified start time and height.

methods.name: get_basic_row
methods.description: Creates a row of basic calendar cells, typically representing a week or month.

methods.name: get_day_head
methods.description: Produces HTML for the header of a day column.

methods.name: display_week
methods.description: Generates HTML for the weekly calendar grid.

methods.name: display_day
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single day calendar grid.

methods.name: display_month
methods.description: Generates HTML for the month view calendar grid.

methods.name: display_shared
methods.description: Produces HTML for shared calendar views among multiple users.

methods.name: display_year
methods.description: Generates HTML for the year overview calendar.
